subject: Sourcing: PO identifier pattern, invoice drip cadence & net-term eligibility
messages:
From: Linda Park <linda.park@novushealth.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novushealth.com
Date: Sun, 8 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sourcing: PO identifiers + invoice cadence question

Hi Ethan,

Thanks for the demo last week — Novus likes Redwood's latency profile and the dedicated pool option. Procurement is working through the contracting checklist and we need a quick confirmation on two things before we route to AP: 1) the canonical PO identifier format you require on invoices (our ERPs tend to enforce a strict alpha-numeric mask), and 2) whether Redwood supports "invoice drip" under a single PO (we sometimes split large POs into weekly/monthly invoices for cashflow).

Specific asks:
- Required PO field(s) to appear on the invoice (PO number, contract id, cost center, Redwood customer id?)
- Max number of invoices you will accept against a single PO and any per-invoice minimums
- Default net terms for new enterprise engagements and whether Net45/Net60 is eligible for approved accounts

Can you send the PO template you prefer and any guidance we should push to AP? We're trying to avoid repeated back-and-forth with our ERP team.

Appreciate a short reply — our SOW is ready and AP wants to know today if we can accept a split-invoice cadence.

Best,
Linda Park
Director, Procurement
Novus Health

--
Novus Health Procurement Team
procurement@novushealth.com

From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
To: Linda Park <linda.park@novushealth.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 8 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sourcing: PO identifiers + invoice cadence question

Linda — thanks for the note and great to hear the SOW is close. Quick answers below and I attached our standard PO template for your ERP team (Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx).

Short version: we support split invoices against a single PO, and we accept Net30 by default. Net45/Net60 can be approved for Enterprise customers pending credit/finance review and a signed commitment (see discount note below).

Required invoice fields (must appear exactly):
- PO Number: free-text field, we accept alpha-numeric masks up to 40 chars (e.g., NOVUS-2027-78912)
- Redwood Account ID: your AP can use the account id we provided in the SOW (Account ID: RWI-55432)
- Invoice Date and Invoice Number (unique per invoice)
- Tax/Vendor name: Redwood Inference, Redwood Inc. (TIN on W9 attached on request)
- Cost center/BU (optional but recommended for faster remittance)

Invoice drip rules and limits:
- Max invoices per PO: we accept up to 12 invoices per PO for large commitments. If you need more than 12 we ask to split to separate PO IDs to avoid reconciliation issues.
- Minimum invoice value: no hard minimum but invoices under $500 may be subject to a manual review — recommend >$1k per invoice for automatic processing.
- Invoice references: each invoice must reference the PO Number and the Redwood Account ID.

Net terms and discount eligibility:
- Default: Net30 (standard for hosted/Dedicated).
- Net45/Net60: eligible after finance review for customers with enterprise contracts or blanket POs; please include expected annual committed spend in the request.
- Volume discount: accounts committing >= $250k ARR are eligible for tiered discounts; terms of commitment (prepay vs. usage-based, cadence) affect discount level — kimberly can outline specifics.

Attachments and next steps:
- Attached: Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx (sample PO header and required fields)
- I'll loop in Kimberly to confirm discount/pricing implications and Vanessa for onboarding scheduling.

If your ERP team wants, we can accept a sample Novus PO (PDF) and I'll have finance verify the header format.

Best,
Ethan Park
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ethan_park@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0176

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Linda Park <linda.park@novushealth.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sourcing: PO identifiers + invoice cadence question

Hi Linda — looping in the pricing note so AP has clarity on discount eligibility tied to invoice/PO structure. A few items from finance/pricing: 

1) Discount and cadence interaction
- If Novus elects a committed ARR (>= $250k annual) and provides a blanket PO, we can apply a tiered volume discount (10% band for first threshold, with deeper tiers at higher spend). The discount applies to invoiced usage under the PO.
- Prepay vs usage-billed: prepay commitments (quarterly/annual) get more favorable discounts. If Novus wants split invoices on a single PO but also expects Net45, finance will require either an explicit commitment statement in the SOW or a short-term prepayment deposit.

2) Net45/Net60 approvals
- Net45 or Net60 will require Credit/Finance review and a signed payment agreement. We typically ask for one of the following: (a) corporate guarantee, (b) a blanket PO with committed minimums, or (c) a prepay/retainer of 15% on initial ramp.

3) ERP/Ops requests (implementation friendly)
- Please ensure each invoice line includes: PO Number, Redwood Account ID (RWI-55432), Invoice Number, Invoice Date, and a single GL/Cost Center reference when possible. Multiple GL lines are okay but slow remittance.

4) Documents we need to onboard Novus to preferred terms
- Signed SOW referencing the blanket PO number
- AP contact and remit-to email for EDI or invoice ingestion
- W9 and tax-exempt certificate (if applicable) — we can send our W9 on request

I'll attach the pricing matrix to this thread in HubSpot and cc Vanessa for onboarding timeline. Ethan — happy for you to share the sample Novus PO for finance verification.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Ethan / Kimberly — thanks, that's exactly the level of detail we needed. I've attached a sample Novus PO (Novus_PO_78912.pdf) so you can confirm the header mask (our ERP enforces NOVUS-YYYY-#####). A couple quick confirmations before I hand to AP: 

- We'll request Net45 on our side. Per Kimberly, we'll include the expected annual committed spend in the finance request (we expect about $320k ARR in year one).
- We plan to use a single blanket PO and split monthly invoices (approx 6 invoices over the first 6 months). That fits within your 12-invoice max.
- Please confirm that a 15% initial retainer is an acceptable alternative to provide credit comfort and allow Net45 terms immediately. If acceptable, please send payment instructions and Redwood's remit-to details.

If finance verifies the Novus PO header, we can proceed to SOW signature and AP will issue the blanket PO next business day.

Best,
Linda Park
Director, Procurement
Novus Health
